title: What is in the hump?
hook: A stored resource can support an animal during scarcity.

knows: Animals have body structures and life histories.
doesNotKnow: Identify the camel hump as a fat reserve.

misconception: A familiar animal feature always has the first explanation that comes to mind.
objective: Identify the camel hump as a fat reserve.

claims.text: What substance makes up much of a camel’s hump and serves as an energy reserve? The cutaway labels the hump as a fat reserve. Camels have several water-conserving adaptations, but their humps are not tanks of drinking water. Fat can provide energy when food is scarce.
claims.source: Source lead, not checked: San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance, camel, https://animals.sandiegozoo.org/animals/camel

claims.text: The one-humped camel, highlighted hump and its label are schematic, not to scale and not an observation. Hump cutaway · schematic.
During a shortage of food, what can a camel gain by using fat stored in its hump? The hump contains fat that can be used as an energy reserve.
claims.source: Source lead, not checked: San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance, camel, https://animals.sandiegozoo.org/animals/camel
